title: fix(core): the outside-closure refusal names the move when the holder already depends on the reader
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXoji6hhHpSoiEVSsF3VSYf)_

Part of #32929

## 维护者速读

- 问题：HotCRM 的 app 包看板读自家 revenue 模块的数据集，18.4.0 候选版返回 409。拒绝语只说「声明对持有包的依赖」，可模块本来就依赖 app，反过来声明会成环，启动直接失败（实测 `Circular dependency detected`）。
- 改法：只改 `outside-closure` 拒绝语。保留原来的「声明依赖」，后面加一句：持有包已经依赖读取方时，把读取的条目搬到持有包，或把被读的条目搬到读取方。
- 裁定：#32929 选二（6840360115）；18.4.0 底线是「文案修正 + HotCRM 自修」（6840525219）。作者期拒绝挪到 18.4.1，另立卡。
- 答案不变：各门的状态码、错误码、`details.candidates`、解析到哪一项，全都不变，只是句子变长。另外修正三个 changeset 里「第一方 0」的说法，点名 HotCRM。
- 风险与回滚：纯文案。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## FROM → TO

| Door | FROM (main a7c97297e) | TO |
|---|---|---|
| Every package-scoped by-name read refused `outside-closure` (dataset query doors single and batch, `/meta/:type/:name?callerPackage=`, the picklist, flow, function, webhook, permission-set readers) | `… held outside the declared dependency closure of package "P": package "Q". Declare a dependency on the package that holds it (ADR-0141).` | Same sentence, then: `If that package already depends on "P", the dependency would be a cycle: move what reads it into that package, or move the <type> into "P" (ADR-0150 D3).` |
| Status, code, `details.candidates`, the resolved item | unchanged | unchanged |
| `.changeset/32072-dataset-resolve-by-package.md` | "first-party count for each: 0" | read in this repository: 0, plus a correction naming HotCRM's CRM Overview tile |
| `.changeset/32310-dataset-caller-package.md` | "Who moves. Nothing first-party sent the parameter" | same, plus a correction: once the console sends it, HotCRM's tile is refused |
| `.changeset/32311-dataset-caller-package-ui.md` | "The fix for those: add the holder to P's `dependencies`, or ship the dataset in P." | same, plus the cycle case (move the reading item into the holder) and HotCRM named |
| `.changeset/32077-dataset-query-package.md` | "No first-party package references a dataset across packages." | same, plus a correction naming HotCRM's CRM Overview tile |

## Measured (step 0 on #32929, main a6be0feee, build-shaped artifact boot)

An app package `com.qa.sib.app` and a module `com.qa.sib.rev` that declares it, both in one namespace. The module holds the object and the dataset; the app's dashboard binds it.
- `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query?callerPackage=com.qa.sib.app` returns 409 `outside-closure`, and so does the batch entry. The query with no package returns 200 (2 rows). `?callerPackage=com.qa.sib.rev` returns 200.
- The fix the old sentence names (the app declares the module) does not boot: `[Kernel] Circular dependency detected: com.qa.sib.rev`.
- Ablation: with #32337's caller arm switched off, the query returns 200/200. With #32804's admission arm switched off, it still returns 409/409.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`: two new cases under `[#32929]`, the whole sentence for a dataset and the type label for an email template. Ablation: putting back the old sentence turns both red (2 failed / 30 passed); restoring it turns them green again (32/32).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: 3362 / 3362 passed, run on b71abe307.
- No other test pins the whole sentence. Every other reader asserts `toContain` on its head (`git grep "held outside the declared dependency closure"` over `*.test.ts`).
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`), run on b71abe307: `--ran` gives 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. 64 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 until its pinned fixture was fetched (shallow clone), then 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 until a full `pnpm build` ran, then 0 (123 entries / 72 packages). `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exits 1: this is the deliberate correction declared below.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION (`check-empty-changeset`)

Four pending release notes are corrected in this PR. Each counted 0 first-party consumers, and HotCRM is one. Where a note says how HotCRM fixes it, it now reads: "HotCRM fixes it in its own release, by moving the dashboard into the module or the dataset into the app package; the HotCRM lane chooses (#32929)." (review S1; ruling 6840525219, "Not ruled here"). The corrected sentences:

- `.changeset/32072-dataset-resolve-by-package.md`: "(first-party count for each, read in this repository: 0 — … ; **corrected by #32929:** one first-party app outside this repository moves with the reader's package — HotCRM's CRM Overview dashboard, in its app package `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, binds the dataset `product_metrics` that its module package `app.objectstack.hotcrm.revenue` holds; …)"
- `.changeset/32310-dataset-caller-package.md`: "- **Who moves.** … **Corrected by #32929:** once the console sends it (`32311-dataset-caller-package-ui`), one first-party app is refused — HotCRM's CRM Overview dashboard …"
- `.changeset/32311-dataset-caller-package-ui.md`: "**The fix for those:** … When the holder already depends on P (a module of the app that reads it), that dependency is a cycle: move the reading item into the holder instead. **First-party (corrected by #32929):** HotCRM's CRM Overview dashboard …"
- `.changeset/32077-dataset-query-package.md`: "No first-party package references a dataset across packages (read in this repository; **corrected by #32929:** one first-party app outside this repository does — HotCRM's CRM Overview dashboard … so once the console sends the item's package the tile is refused where it drew on 18.3.0; … Other first-party apps outside this repository: not measured)." (review S2)

The dispatching seat confirms these by its own record.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, carried to a follow-up card under #32929 (18.4.1):**
  - Authoring refusal: `indexResolvableDatasets` (`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts`) still treats every body of the artifact as resolution context, so `os validate` / `os build` keep accepting the tile the runtime refuses. A work-in-progress commit is on `claude/project-thread-ldkwcp-pr2` (c0ccb673b, not tested on that head).
  - The CLI picklist hint (`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts` `refusedReferenceHint`) and the publish probe's `widget_not_probed` fix (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts` `datasetNotProbed`) still name only the dependency.
  - Whether the three app actions in HotCRM that launch module flows are refused: not measured.
- HotCRM's own fix (move the dashboard into the revenue module) is the hotcrm card that is `Blocked-by: #32929`; this PR does not touch it.
- Wording only: no package's answer moves, so no first-party consumer count changes.
